concept: One meeting room, one comment rebuilt in front of us. A friendly, vague line after an overrun gets a nod and changes nothing; the clock overruns again. A label makes it worse; what the clock showed is the usable part. The same bubble becomes a message card that grows line by line (what you saw, its impact, an agreed next step) while the colleague's face moves from easy to attentive. The viewer checks it on a different moment (a handover note missing a deadline), sees the talk done soon and two-way in a quiet corner, sees praise made specific at their own desk, gets a blank card to fill, and the room returns a week on with the clock at the end mark.
world: Stations: room (0,0) the meeting room two-shot, Asha the giver left, Ben the colleague right, wall clock upper right, card space in the wall centre; presenter (0,1300) b03 only; desk (2200,0) the viewer's own desk, nobody at it, b06 b14 b15; handover (4400,0) a desk top with a handover note and three option cards, b11 b12; corner (2200,1300) a quiet corner by a window, same sides as the room, b13. Cast: Presenter (woman, skin 0, accent3), Asha (woman, skin 2, cloth, screen left), Ben (man, skin 1, cloth2, flip, screen right); peep busts; extras muted via ctx.crowd.
look: story-cartoon: warm paper ground, flat fills with one cel shade, ink outlines, words on props, one accent per frame on the thing the narration names.

devices.what: Asha's one speech bubble: the vague line (b01), emptied (b04), turned into a paper card that grows line 1 what you saw (b07), line 2 impact (b08), part labels and SBI once (b09), line 3 next step with an agreed tick (b10), edited small in the corner (b13), and as the viewer's blank four-slot card (b15).
The same meeting room two-shot, Asha left, Ben right, same looks and sides, faces carrying the reaction.
The room's wall clock with a small end-time mark: before the mark (b01), hands past it (b02), the twenty-minute overrun arc shaded (b05, b07), hands on the mark (b16).
The viewer's desk: a Good job sticky with an empty space where the action would be (b06); beside it a specific note tied to the timed agenda (b14); a blank four-slot card (b15).
The one join material: a paper page turn into the check (b11), into the quiet corner (b13), and at the week skip into the payoff (b16).

value_script.why: a pale open: the line that changed nothing

value_script.accent: the label, the overrun arc, then each card line as it fills
value_script.why: a slightly richer middle while the mechanism is taught

value_script.accent: the missing deadline gap, withheld from the options until the answer
value_script.why: the three options weigh the same until the answer

value_script.accent: the clock hand on the end mark
value_script.why: a lift at the payoff: the same room, the change visible

sections.treatment: Cut open in the room on the vague line and the nod; continue a week on as the clock passes the mark; cut to the presenter's one-line promise.
sections.accent_on: the vague bubble, then the clock

beats.line: Asha's bubble pops with Maybe tighten it up?; Ben smiles and nods; both easy.
A week on: the bubble leaves, extras sit, the clock hand sweeps past the end mark while Ben still talks; Asha's face falls.
The presenter promises, in one line, a talk that sticks; her card previews Behaviour, Impact, Next step.

sections.treatment: Back in the room: the nod frozen, the bubble emptied; then a label versus what the clock showed, the seen side ticked; camera to the viewer's desk for a quiet recall.
sections.accent_on: the empty bubble, then the overrun arc, then the empty space on the note

beats.line: The nod freezes; the bubble empties to a dashed hollow: nothing to act on.
A You're disorganised tag sticks on Ben and he bristles, it is crossed and peels away; the clock's twenty-minute overrun arc lights and Ben looks at it, ticked as the one to use.
The viewer's desk: a Good job sticky with an empty space under it; a still, thinking hold.

sections.treatment: Camera back to the room: the bubble becomes a card and grows across four continue joins, Ben's face moving from easy to attentive to agreeing; a page turn to the handover check and its answer.

beats.line: The bubble reshapes into a card with three dashed slots; line 1 writes in as spoken; Ben turns attentive.
Line 2 Impact writes in, the accent, slow; two extras hurry out late behind; Ben turns thoughtful.
Small part tags land on lines 1 and 2, the SBI heading once and small; the third slot pulses open.
Line 3 fills; a paper agenda on the table gains its times; a pos tick: agreed; Ben nods, this time with a plan.
Page turn: a handover note with a dashed gap where the deadline should be, the question, three equal option cards, a pause ring through the silence.
C ticked and its three parts light; B dims with three empty outline slots; A crossed.

sections.treatment: A page turn to a quiet corner the same afternoon: Asha asks, Ben talks, she listens, line 3 is edited together; camera to the desk where praise is made specific.
sections.accent_on: the edited line, then the specific note

beats.line: Quiet corner: Soon, in private sign on the moment; Asha asks, Ben's bubble talks, Asha listens; line 3 on the small card is edited.
The Good job sticky returns, still empty; beside it a specific note What worked, so keep it, its space filled with the timed agenda, a line joining them.

sections.treatment: On the desk the viewer's blank four-slot card; a page turn to the room a week on, the clock on the end mark and specific praise.
sections.accent_on: the blank card's slots, then the clock hand on the mark

beats.line: A blank card for the viewer lands on the desk with four slots, Behaviour, Impact, Next step, Ask, each lighting as spoken; a pause to think.
Page turn a week on: the agenda pinned by the clock, the hand reaches the end mark, extras leave on time; Asha's specific praise bubble, both smile.

alternatives: b11 and b12 as the quiz.question and quiz.answer templates (kept as an option; not chosen because the handover note must be seen and an earlier lesson's critic flagged the template's uneven option grid).
open_questions: Peep busts have only neutral, happy, surprised and explaining faces: Ben's bristle in b05 reads as surprised plus the tag, not a scowl.
